en.title: Story Time Reader
en.description: Read a book or a story page for 15 minutes, then tell someone at home your favourite part.

roles.child: Reads quietly, then shares the best part of the story

steps: Pick a book or a story you like
Read quietly for 15 minutes
Tell a family member your favourite part

en.title: Draw My Family
en.description: Draw a picture of your family doing something happy together and show it to them.

roles.child: Draws the picture and explains it

steps: Find paper and a pencil or colours
Draw your family doing something you all enjoy
Show your drawing and explain who is who

en.title: Tidy Room Hero
en.description: Make your sleeping area neat. Fold your clothes and put everything back where it belongs.

roles.child: Folds, sorts and puts things back in their place

steps: Fold your blanket and your clothes
Put books, shoes and toys back in their place
Ask a family member to come and see your tidy space

en.title: Animal Moves
en.description: Move like five different animals inside your home. Hop like a frog, stretch like a cat and stand tall like a giraffe.

roles.child: Clears a little space and copies each animal

steps: Clear a little space on the floor
Move like five animals, ten moves each
Drink some water and rest

en.title: Counting Collector
en.description: Collect 20 small things at home, like bottle caps or beans, and sort them by colour or size.

roles.child: Collects, counts and sorts the items, then puts them back

steps: Collect 20 small things from around the house
Sort them into groups by colour or size
Count each group out loud
Put everything back where you found it

en.title: Thank You Note
en.description: Write or draw a short thank you note for someone in your family and give it to them.

roles.child: Writes or draws the note and hands it over

steps: Choose someone in your family to thank
Write or draw why you are thankful for them
Give them the note with a smile

en.title: Balance Champion
en.description: Stand on one leg like a stork and count how long you can stay still. Try both legs three times.

roles.child: Balances, counts and tries to beat their own best count

steps: Stand in a clear space away from furniture
Balance on one leg and count out loud
Switch legs and try three times each

en.title: Word Explorer
en.description: Learn three new words in Amharic, Afaan Oromoo or English and use each one in a sentence.

roles.child: Finds three new words and makes a sentence with each

steps: Ask a family member or look in a book for three new words
Say each word out loud three times
Make one sentence with each word

en.title: Shiro Helper
en.description: Help your parent prepare shiro for the family. You get the bowls and powder ready, and your parent does the cooking.

roles.child: Washes hands, measures the shiro powder into a bowl and sets out the plates
roles.parent: Does all the cooking at the stove, all the cutting, and carries anything hot

steps: Wash your hands together
Child measures the shiro powder into a bowl
Parent cooks the shiro while the child sets out the plates
Eat together and say what you liked most
en.supervision_note: Only the parent works at the stove and does the cutting. The child stays back from hot pots.

en.title: Injera Table Helper
en.description: Help get the family meal ready. Roll the injera, arrange the tray and call everyone to eat.

roles.child: Washes hands, rolls the injera and arranges it on the tray
roles.parent: Prepares the food and carries every hot dish

steps: Wash your hands well
Roll the injera and arrange it neatly on the tray
Parent brings the hot dishes to the table
Call everyone to eat together
en.supervision_note: The parent carries all hot food. The child only handles the injera and the tray.

en.title: Coffee Ceremony Helper
en.description: Help with the family coffee ceremony. Arrange the cups, spread the grass and serve the snack to everyone.

roles.child: Spreads the grass, arranges the cups and serves the popcorn or kolo
roles.parent: Roasts, grinds and pours the coffee, and handles everything hot

steps: Spread the grass and arrange the small cups
Parent roasts and prepares the coffee
Child serves popcorn or kolo to everyone
Help collect the cups when the ceremony ends
en.supervision_note: Only the adult touches the stove, the jebena and the hot coffee. The child serves the snack and stays seated nearby.

en.title: Compound Clean-Up Team
en.description: Tidy the family compound together. Sweep the leaves and put things back in their place.

roles.child: Sweeps leaves into a pile and collects things that belong inside
roles.parent: Lifts heavy things, handles anything broken or dirty, and takes out the rubbish

steps: Choose one part of the compound to tidy
Child sweeps the leaves into a pile
Parent removes the pile and anything heavy or broken
Wash your hands together when you finish
en.supervision_note: The parent handles anything heavy, broken or dirty. The child uses only a broom.

en.title: Gebeta Game Time
en.description: Play gebeta with a parent or grandparent. Use a board, or small holes in the soil and pebbles.

roles.child: Sets up the pebbles and takes turns kindly
roles.parent: Explains the rules and plays along

steps: Set up the gebeta board, or make small holes in the soil and collect pebbles
Ask your parent to explain the rules
Play two rounds and cheer for each other
en.supervision_note: Play for fun and cheer for each other. An adult stays with the child for the whole game.

en.title: Family Story Circle
en.description: Ask a parent or grandparent to tell you a story from when they were young, then tell it back in your own words.

roles.child: Listens carefully, asks one question and retells the story
roles.parent: Tells a story from their childhood or a traditional tale

steps: Sit together in a comfortable place
Listen to the story without interrupting
Ask one question about the story
Tell the story back in your own words
en.supervision_note: A calm time together with no screens nearby.

en.title: Laundry Folding Team
en.description: Fold the clean clothes together. Pair the socks, fold the small things and carry your own pile.

roles.child: Pairs the socks and folds the small clothes
roles.parent: Folds the big items and puts clothes on the top shelves

steps: Sort the clean clothes into piles for each person
Child pairs the socks and folds the small clothes
Parent folds the big items
Carry your own pile to where it belongs
en.supervision_note: The parent reaches the top shelves and carries the heavy piles.

en.title: Eskista Dance Time
en.description: Dance eskista together for ten minutes. Clap or sing the rhythm yourselves, with no screens.

roles.child: Picks the song to sing and copies the shoulder moves
roles.parent: Shows the moves and claps the rhythm

steps: Clear a little space in the room
Clap or sing a song you both know
Dance together for ten minutes
Drink some water and rest
en.supervision_note: Dance in a clear space away from furniture. An adult joins in.

en.title: Plant Care Team
en.description: Look after the plants at home together. Give them water and remove the dry leaves.

roles.child: Waters the plants with a small cup and picks off dry leaves
roles.parent: Carries the heavy water container and shows how much water each plant needs

steps: Fill a small cup with water with your parent
Water each plant slowly at the roots
Pick off the dry leaves and put them in the rubbish
Wash your hands when you finish
en.supervision_note: The parent carries the heavy water container. The child uses only a small cup.

en.title: Read Aloud Together
en.description: Read a story out loud with a parent. Take turns reading one page each.

roles.child: Reads one page out loud, then listens
roles.parent: Reads the next page and helps with hard words

steps: Choose a book or story together
Take turns reading one page each
Talk about what might happen next
en.supervision_note: A quiet time together with no screens nearby.

en.title: Football With Approved Friends
en.description: Play football for 30 minutes with approved friends, in a place your parent chooses.

roles.child: Asks permission, plays fairly and comes home on time
roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can play and where
Play football in the place your parent approved
Come home when the 30 minutes are over
Tell your parent about the game
en.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 30 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.

en.title: Jump Rope With Approved Friends
en.description: Jump rope for 20 minutes with approved friends, in the compound or a place your parent approves.

roles.child: Asks permission, takes turns and comes home on time
roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can join and where to play
Take turns jumping and turning the rope
Count the jumps for each other and cheer
Come home after 20 minutes
en.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 20 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.

en.title: Segno Maksegno Hopscotch
en.description: Draw the squares on the ground and play Segno Maksegno with approved friends for 20 minutes.

roles.child: Asks permission, draws the squares and takes turns
roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can play and where
Draw the squares on the ground with a stick or chalk
Take turns hopping through the squares
Come home after 20 minutes
en.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 20 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.

en.title: Abarosh Tag Game
en.description: Play abarosh, the chasing game, with approved friends for 20 minutes in a place your parent approves.

roles.child: Asks permission, plays gently and comes home on time
roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can play and where
Agree together where the play area ends
Take turns being the chaser
Come home after 20 minutes and drink some water
en.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 20 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.

en.title: Nature Treasure Hunt
en.description: With approved friends, find five things from nature in the compound: a leaf, a smooth stone, a feather, a flower and a seed.

roles.child: Asks permission, searches with friends and shows what they found
roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can join and where to look
Look for the five nature treasures together
Show your parent what you found
Come home after 20 minutes and wash your hands
en.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 20 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.

en.title: Friendly Relay Run
en.description: Run a relay with approved friends in the place your parent approves. Mix the teams and cheer for everyone.

roles.child: Asks permission, runs in a mixed team and cheers for everyone
roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can join and where to run
Mark a start line and a turning point
Run in mixed teams and cheer for everyone
Come home after 20 minutes and drink some water
en.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 20 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.

roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can play and where
Play football in the place your parent approved
Come home when the 30 minutes are over
Tell your parent about the game
om.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 30 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.

om.title: Jump Rope With Approved Friends
om.description: Jump rope for 20 minutes with approved friends, in the compound or a place your parent approves.

roles.child: Asks permission, takes turns and comes home on time
roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can join and where to play
Take turns jumping and turning the rope
Count the jumps for each other and cheer
Come home after 20 minutes
om.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 20 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.

om.title: Segno Maksegno Hopscotch
om.description: Draw the squares on the ground and play Segno Maksegno with approved friends for 20 minutes.

roles.child: Asks permission, draws the squares and takes turns
roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can play and where
Draw the squares on the ground with a stick or chalk
Take turns hopping through the squares
Come home after 20 minutes
om.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 20 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.

om.title: Abarosh Tag Game
om.description: Play abarosh, the chasing game, with approved friends for 20 minutes in a place your parent approves.

roles.child: Asks permission, plays gently and comes home on time
roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can play and where
Agree together where the play area ends
Take turns being the chaser
Come home after 20 minutes and drink some water
om.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 20 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.

om.title: Nature Treasure Hunt
om.description: With approved friends, find five things from nature in the compound: a leaf, a smooth stone, a feather, a flower and a seed.

roles.child: Asks permission, searches with friends and shows what they found
roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can join and where to look
Look for the five nature treasures together
Show your parent what you found
Come home after 20 minutes and wash your hands
om.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 20 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.

om.title: Friendly Relay Run
om.description: Run a relay with approved friends in the place your parent approves. Mix the teams and cheer for everyone.

roles.child: Asks permission, runs in a mixed team and cheers for everyone
roles.parent: Approves the friends, the place and the time limit

steps: Ask your parent which approved friends can join and where to run
Mark a start line and a turning point
Run in mixed teams and cheer for everyone
Come home after 20 minutes and drink some water
om.supervision_note: Parent approves the friends, the place and the 20 minute limit. Stay together in the approved place and come home on time.
